title: Chapter 6: Beauty Make-up
html:
Chen Ge’s Haunted House had only two scenarios available at the moment: Night of the Living Dead and Minghun.

The black phone had harshly criticized Night of the Living Dead. Looking at it as objectively as he could, Chen Ge had to admit the scenario had plenty of flaws. More importantly, it required at least three employees to operate properly.

“Xiao Wan, Minghun will be our main attraction today. Once I finish setting up the background music, remember to wear your earphones while you work. Also, I’ll be doing your makeup today.”

“Boss, you know how to do makeup?” Xiao Wan teased. “Fine, but if you mess it up, I’m doing it myself.”

“Don’t worry, I’ll make you look so beautiful that you’ll take their breath away.”

They entered the makeup room. Chen Ge seated Xiao Wan in front of the mirror and gently massaged her face with his palm.

“Activating Elementary Skill—Mortician’s Makeup.”

As he looked at the young woman in the mirror, unfamiliar memories and knowledge suddenly flooded Chen Ge’s mind. The information came in a chaotic rush: color theory and makeup techniques, human anatomy and physiology, bone structure, and even the study of death.

“Boss, are you sure you know how to do makeup?” Thirty seconds passed. Xu Wan sat before the mirror, watching her boss work on her reflection. His touch felt unfamiliar, and for some reason her heart began to race with nervous embarrassment.

“A good makeup artist tailors the style to the client’s features. And Xiao Wan, I have to say, you’ve given me a very good foundation to work with.” Chen Ge had no inappropriate thoughts whatsoever. The moment he activated Mortician’s Makeup, Xu Wan had already become a ‘corpse’ in his mind.

“Hammer, shaver, scalpel, needle and thread, formaldehyde, alcohol… sigh. I’m missing everything. Looks like I’ll have to settle for basic makeup,” Chen Ge muttered, thoroughly unsettling Xu Wan. She could not understand why her boss thought he needed such alarming equipment for Haunted House makeup. She was already a little nervous, but since refusing him felt awkward, all she could do was watch the process through half-closed eyes and hope for the best.

“The foundation is too flat, and the blush is too bright. And where’s the lipstick?” Chen Ge grumbled as he began mixing colors. The confidence and precision of his movements hardly matched the image of a geek who supposedly knew nothing about makeup.

Xu Wan herself seemed baffled by what was happening.Mixing colors without online guides or reference books? That’s some seriously advanced makeup technique!

“Boss, I don’t think you should be so hard on yourself. After all, the lighting in the Haunted House is so dim; the visitors wouldn’t be able to see anything.”

“Shush and stop moving,” Chen Ge interrupted. He applied the eyeshadow he had just mixed with only a few strokes, yet the effect transformed Xu Wan’s appearance, lending her an air of cold, mysterious beauty.

Xu Wan’s first instinct was to tease her boss, but when she saw her reflection, her mouth fell open.

“Cherry Red alone is too flat; it doesn’t have enough depth. Mix in a little purple, though, and it becomes completely different. The colors blend as if they were made for each other,” Chen Ge explained like a makeup expert while mixing the two shades on the back of his hand.

“Boss, what are you doing?”

“The Haunted House’s blush is too gaudy because it’s meant to create a strong visual effect, but that goes a little too far. I’m softening it by working it on my hand before applying it.” Chen Ge moved carefully, and after a few minutes the color looked smoother and more natural, with an added brightening effect.

Xu Wan’s mouth formed a perfect O. “Boss, you’re amazing! Where did you learn to do this?”

“You haven’t seen half my talents yet. Makeup and beauty techniques are just things I dabble in during my free time,” Chen Ge said with a smile. He was in an excellent mood; he finally had concrete proof that the phone app could affect reality.

In only ten minutes, Chen Ge finished Xu Wan’s makeup. “All right, take a look. What do you think?”

The woman in the mirror looked as though she had stepped out of a watercolor painting—a classical beauty, elegant at first glance, yet somehow unsettling.

Unable to help herself, Xu Wan stood and twirled in front of the mirror. Her shock gave way to fascination, then finally to a shudder.

“Boss, I’ve never looked this beautiful in my life. Is that really me?”

“Of course it is.”

“But…” She hesitantly reached toward the mirror. “Why does it feel like I’m looking at a dead person?”

Xu Wan’s observation made Chen Ge inhale sharply as well. A mortician’s makeup was meant to bring out the beauty of the dead, so naturally his new skill was not designed with the living in mind.

“Don’t worry about it. The park is opening soon, so hurry up, get changed, and take your position in the Minghun scenario on the second floor. Remember to wear your Bluetooth earpiece and follow my instructions.” Chen Ge tactfully changed the subject and sent Xu Wan off to work. With the little time remaining, he touched up the puppets and mannequins in Minghun. Thanks to Mortician’s Makeup, they all looked disturbingly lifelike.

“That’ll do for now. I can recolor them when I have time.” Chen Ge packed up his toolbox and hurried downstairs. Before he even reached the entrance, he could hear visitors talking outside.

“You’re here to get revenge on that shameless bastard too?”

“Yes! The creep caused me to drop my phone, and it broke, so what do you think?”

“You guys got off easy. I was changing when that thing suddenly popped up! I screamed so loudly my parents rushed into my room to see what had happened. You can imagine how awkward that was…”

…

Listening to the visitors complain, Chen Ge struggled not to laugh. He took a deep breath, arranged his face into a serious expression, and pushed open the entrance.

“Welcome to my humble House of Horrors.”

Chen Ge’s lips curled into a smile when he saw the long line of customers.

“Xiao Chen, your place is already packed this early? Not bad.” A worker repairing the carousel looked over in surprise. He was about to come greet Chen Ge when he noticed the visitors’ expressions. They did not look like ordinary, cheerful parkgoers.

“It’s okay; I’m just glad for the support.” Chen Ge shrugged as he pulled the gate open.

“Who said we’re here to support you? Shameless!”

“We’re here to resolve debts, not to play!”

“Is that really him? You’re the one who uploaded that video last night? Come out here!”

The visitors were so ‘enthusiastic’ that the entrance dissolved into chaos, but Chen Ge raised his voice over them. “Since you’re already here, why not come inside and try the Haunted House? The best way to overcome one fear is sometimes with a stronger dose of it—fight poison with poison, so to speak. Yesterday’s video should have come with more warning, and I apologize for that. How about this: all Haunted House tickets are fifty percent off today. Don’t miss the chance!”
